complete.methodology: Crisis pattern signatures extracted from 9 historical auction PDFs covering 2008-09-17 through 2024-10-09. Each live auction scored 0-100 against 6 patterns. v2 adds: tenor-level decomposition, 30-day forward calendar with unvalidated per-auction heuristics, cosine-similarity matching vs 9 historical crisis anchors, dated FRED context (repo, USD, curve, inflation), 30-day composite history, 3 forward-looking tail risk concern scores (uncalibrated, not event probabilities), and named thresholds. v2.1 adds pre-auction nominal benchmark changes (five/one observation intervals leading up to upcoming auctions) and dated benchmark changes after issue (1d/5d/30d targets) with explicit dates and gaps. These are not same-security returns or validated portfolio instructions.

metric_definitions.allocated_at_high_pct: Percentage of bids at the high rate/yield that were awarded; marginal-bid proration, not dealer absorption or a when-issued tail.
metric_definitions.indirect_pct: Accepted bids submitted through intermediaries; includes domestic and foreign investors. Not foreign demand.
metric_definitions.primary_dealer_pct: Primary dealer accepted share, separate from allotted-at-high.

metric_definitions.tail_bp: Unavailable without a timestamped same-security when-issued quote. This legacy key is retained as null.
metric_definitions.high_minus_median_bp: Within-auction high-minus-median quote dispersion in basis points on one explicitly named quote basis; not a WI tail.
metric_definitions.bidder_denominator_usd: Sum of all three accepted bidder amounts only when each is present, finite and nonnegative. Zero denominators have no shares.

all_matches.duration: Crisis acute for 8-10 weeks. Full resolution into Q1 2009.

all_matches.duration: Multi-quarter crisis. Federal funds rate to zero by Dec.

all_matches.context: Bill auction with AAH=6.92 — extreme low-end clustering.
all_matches.what_happened_next: Continued through Oct 8. TIPS auction also stressed.
all_matches.duration: Bill stress lasted ~4 months.

all_matches.context: TIPS auction at the height of Q4 2008 crisis. Real yields elevated.
all_matches.what_happened_next: S&P bottom in March 2009. 5y TIPS yields normalized over Q1-Q2 2009.
all_matches.duration: Real yield distortion persisted into 2010.

all_matches.context: Day WHO declared pandemic. Pre-Fed bazooka. Risk-off cascade beginning.
all_matches.what_happened_next: Mar 15 Fed cut to zero + QE. Mar 23 unlimited QE announced. S&P +75% by Sep 2020.
all_matches.duration: Acute panic 3-4 weeks. Full risk-on regime by August.

all_matches.context: Peak COVID panic. AAH=53.83, indirect collapse to 46%. Funding stress acute.
all_matches.what_happened_next: Mar 23 unlimited QE + Main Street Lending. Lowest stock price 3 days later.
all_matches.duration: Acute for 3 weeks, then explosive recovery.

all_matches.context: First post-bazooka auction. BTC=4.74 = MASSIVE demand for safe assets at zero.
all_matches.what_happened_next: Demand for Treasuries continued through April. Equity recovery began.
all_matches.duration: Stampede pattern lasted ~6 weeks.

all_matches.context: Late-cycle complacency. Crypto top imminent (Nov 8). BTC=3.52 (modestly elevated).
all_matches.what_happened_next: Crypto peak Nov 8. S&P peak Jan 2022. -25% drawdown into Oct 2022.
all_matches.duration: Inflation regime + tightening cycle began Jan 2022.

many.methodology: Crisis pattern signatures extracted from 9 historical auction PDFs covering 2008-09-17 through 2024-10-09. Each live auction scored 0-100 against 6 patterns. v2 adds: tenor-level decomposition, 30-day forward calendar with unvalidated per-auction heuristics, cosine-similarity matching vs 9 historical crisis anchors, dated FRED context (repo, USD, curve, inflation), 30-day composite history, 3 forward-looking tail risk concern scores (uncalibrated, not event probabilities), and named thresholds. v2.1 adds pre-auction nominal benchmark changes (five/one observation intervals leading up to upcoming auctions) and dated benchmark changes after issue (1d/5d/30d targets) with explicit dates and gaps. These are not same-security returns or validated portfolio instructions.

metric_definitions.allocated_at_high_pct: Percentage of bids at the high rate/yield that were awarded; marginal-bid proration, not dealer absorption or a when-issued tail.
metric_definitions.indirect_pct: Accepted bids submitted through intermediaries; includes domestic and foreign investors. Not foreign demand.
metric_definitions.primary_dealer_pct: Primary dealer accepted share, separate from allotted-at-high.
metric_definitions.tail_risk: Uncalibrated 0-100 heuristic concern scores. Probability fields are null; no validated forecast horizon.
metric_definitions.tail_bp: Unavailable without a timestamped same-security when-issued quote. This legacy key is retained as null.
metric_definitions.high_minus_median_bp: Within-auction high-minus-median quote dispersion in basis points on one explicitly named quote basis; not a WI tail.
metric_definitions.bidder_denominator_usd: Sum of all three accepted bidder amounts only when each is present, finite and nonnegative. Zero denominators have no shares.

score_validation.note: Dated observations do not validate fixed historical baselines, forward forecasts or investment actions.
